summary: Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd., a Cayman Islands company listed on NASDAQ, filed a Form 6-K on June 12, 2026, announcing the pricing of a registered direct offering. The offering comprises up to 1,133,332 Class A ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants for up to 200,000 shares, at a combined price of $1.50 per unit, with gross proceeds of approximately $2.0 million. The offering is expected to close on June 15, 2026, and is conducted under an effective shelf registration statement. D. Boral Capital LLC serves as placement agent. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. Watch for dilution but no risk-arb angle.
